profile_text.body:
Adobe is a public company founded in 1982 and headquartered in San Jose, CA. It trades on the public markets under the ticker ADBE and, according to its most recent 10-K filing covering the period ending November 28, 2025, reported revenue of $23,769,000,000. The company's website for Adobe Express describes it as an all-in-one design, photo, and video tool intended to make content creation easy, with the site promoting quick creation of social content, videos, and logos.

Adobe's tracked AI products span several categories. Adobe Express AI is described as a lightweight design tool with integration of Adobe Firefly, and the site notes an AI Assistant that allows users to prompt, create, and edit content while preserving chosen elements. Adobe Firefly is positioned as a standalone image generation product, with Adobe claiming it is trained on commercially safe data. Premiere Pro AI extends the company's professional video editing software with generative features including generative extend and color match, also under a commercially safe training claim. Adobe Podcast AI offers audio enhancement capabilities including speech enhancement and microphone check, with a similar commercial-safe training claim attached.

The held facts record no litigation cases or MCP server presence for Adobe at this time. The company holds a verified SEC CIK of 0000796343, confirming its status as a publicly registered, for-profit organization.
